prompt: This oil painting depicts a fire station interior. On the left, a firefighter in yellow gear stands holding a coiled hose. In the center, a dalmatian sits calmly on the polished concrete floor. To the right, an older man in a blue shirt leans against a red locker. Next to him, a small child in a green jacket points at a shiny brass helmet resting on a wooden bench. A black cat perches on top of the same bench, looking down at the dog. The firefighter is handing a badge to the older man. The child is standing next to the older man. There is no smoke.
